product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native banking operating system for banks to modernize core infrastructure, automate operational workflows, and build and deploy custom agents.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing plans or pricing navigation were found; the pricing path returns the homepage content.

named_customers.notes: Only one named customer/design partner was verified: Emprise Bank, announced October 15, 2026; no second name was found. The empty list follows the requested fewer-than-two rule.

employee_band.notes: The banking company reports 11–50 employees on LinkedIn, which cannot distinguish the requested 11–20 and 21–50 bands.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook gives 2025, consistent with the founder’s January 2025 start; the company LinkedIn page instead lists 2026, its public-launch year.

eng_blog.notes: No company blog was found; its newsroom contains external launch and investment coverage, not engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The documentation portal is access-controlled and requires a work-email login code and access from a Maximum representative; no public multi-article documentation was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed roles are Senior Staff Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, and Senior Software Engineer; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No model provider was disclosed in the public site, newsroom, careers, terms, or privacy/subprocessor disclosures; product documentation requires access.

compliance_certs.notes: The public legal/privacy page names none of the five requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 3, 2026; PitchBook records this as its sole financing round.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 3, 2026 seed announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public careers page lists only software-engineering openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum emerged from stealth on August 3, 2026, introducing its AI-native operating system for banks within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Alex Steiner’s profile dates his start as Chief Revenue Officer at Maximum to August 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job postings name no CRM or sales/marketing system.
